notes.title: ¡MITE! We released the full version!
notes.content:
New:


 Updated AI system, now the AI can push you.

 New AI, adds different types of AI, with which to interact.

 New collection system along with your own achievement, collect the items to earn "The Collector" achievement.

 New more immersive sounds and now 3D audio.

 New arrow system, collect wood and ropes, to create arrows and guide you in the forest...

 New interactive paths.

 New decoration to accompany the player.

 Changes in the creatures, we remove old creatures and add new ones, to control and improve the environment.

 Adjustments in flashlight light, visual improvements.

 New optimization settings on small objects.

 Changes in achievements.



Kanashi:

We have updated many things, to improve the experience in the forest, it is not an easy game to pass, I challenge you to it.

Chapter 1 is an intro, and it's done, once you get chapter 1 you get all the others for free in one update.

We want to thank the people who tried, tried, tried MITE in Early Access and the people who download it now.

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Three new creatures.

 Adjustments in the scares, now the illusion effect is activated.

 New help kinematics.

 New settings in the flashlight.

 Physics in MITE, in the menu.

 New sounds.



Information:

We are improving and updating this introductory chapter quite often to deliver the best final product, chapter one is an introduction to the second.


Chapter 2 Information:

Chapter two is planned for March-April, it is a longer chapter and we plan to release it together with the full version of MITE, without paying anything else, it will be an update (2.0).


Web: https://www.kanashi.site/

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/bDHMaxj4wa

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Changes in the mechanics of scares.

 We added newspapers on the map.

 New creature.

 Fixed pause bug, sounds now stop.

 We set the final time, to give time to read the end and we added a background.

 Added group of creatures.

 Small fixes and corrections.



I want to thank you for testing this game in Early Access, thanks to this, we can improve before its release.

I'm just a developer, so any review is welcome, if it's positive you'll brighten the life of a small developer who lives on an island, Tenerife. Thank you so much!

There is still a lot of content missing, which we will be uploading throughout this week, more creatures...!
